PRED-18.G1 (deposit 18, registered 2026-02-20) and PRED-264.G1 (2026-01-07): low deposit numbers carry later dates in this batch (also PRED-1.G7 at 2026-06-19, PRED-89.G2 at 2026-05-05, PRED-123.F1 at 2026-05-23); the numbering is not chronological, which is consistent with legacy numbering, not flagged as a wrong date.
